overview: A single-page endless jet-ski game where you ride a swell past buoys and docks along a realistic sunset coastline.
features: Charge and release a swell to launch the jet-ski rider
Dodge red channel buoys and wooden docks as they scroll past
Distance scoring with speed and spawn rate that scale as you go
Session high score saved and shown on the game over screen
Realistic 2.5D sunset scene with smooth water, soft foam and atmospheric depth
